capabilities: Insert random names into a document
Draw from multiple categories of people and item names
extras: README contains only build and manual install instructions, not end-user usage documentation; it references an internal name source whose full list is documented elsewhere.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert random generated names, such as for fictional characters or items.
summary: Random name generator that inserts names from categories of people and items into the current document.
